resources.string: In writing mode, lift your finger and pause to insert the top prediction. Starting another stroke resets the timer. Predictions can be wrong; undo or correct them. Automatic insertion never saves training examples.
Pause to insert the predicted character…
Prediction inserted. Undo or correct it if needed; it was not learned.
An uncertain prediction was inserted. Please check it; it was not learned.
Writing pause updated. Finish a new stroke to start its timer.
Prediction removed. Choose the intended character, or draw another stroke.
Built-in starter shapes cover every letter and digit, even before training. Personal examples improve matching to your handwriting. Counts below show your own saved examples, not the built-in shapes.

Starter shapes are bundled with the app and contain no child data. Automatic writing is on by default after a 1.2-second pause and can be turned off. It inserts predictions into your draft or the current app without saving them as training. A recent non-private handwriting result and its drawing may be kept briefly in memory for Undo; they are cleared when their input context changes.
